body:
Dear Developers:

Thank you for your contribution! 

Is there an estimated timeline of releasing the additional road annotations (3D lane lines etc.) of PhysicalAIAV dataset, as is indicated in https://github.com/NVlabs/physical_ai_av/wiki/5.-Machine-Labels-(Coming-Soon)?

Thanks!

(Also, I have posted the question on your official forum as guided and the original post is [here](https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/release-plan-of-more-labels/379200))

comments.body:
Unfortunately, I probably can't answer this. It does seem like https://github.com/NVlabs/physical_ai_av/issues might be a better place to ask that.

I'm going to close this for now, but if you don't get any traction after a reasonable amount of time, feel free to reopen this and I can start trying to track down the internal team (different from this one).

title: Release Plan of Road Annotations in PhysicalAIAV Dataset
